title: Knights of the Round Table
summary: The Knights of the Round Table were an order of knights formed by King Arthur to protect his kingdom and, later, undertook the quest for the Holy Grail. One of its members, Sir Lancelot, was head of one of the main branch families of the Casterwill family, and later fell from grace after falling in love with Guinevere, Arthur's wife.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
One of the knights, [[Sir Gawain]], was the nephew of King Arthur, and was named after the King's Titan, [[Gawain]]. {{source|Huntik.com}} 

The Knights of the Round Table were sent by Arthur on a quest to find the Holy Grail. Three of the knights, Bors, Galahad and Perceval succeeded in their quest and their statues stood in the [[Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot]], alongside that of Lancelot himself who failed due to being unworthy after falling in love with [[Guinevere]]. {{Source|Memory Lane}}
